simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תּוּגָה (H8424) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תּוּגָה (tûwgâh) means depression (of spirits); concretely a grief First listed occurrence: Prov 10 1.

definitions.full: H8424. tugah תּוּגָה noun feminine grief (poetry) — absolute ׳ת Psa 119:28 ; Prov 14:13 ; 17:21 ; construct תּוּגַת 10:1 ; — grief Psa 119:28 ; Prov 10:1 (opposed to יְשַׂמַּח ), 14:13 (opposed to שִׂמְחָה ), 17:21 (|| יִשְׂמַח לֹא ).
